Subject: Arrival stagger, vanpool tiers, and key-drop protocol for StratusHealth workshop

Hi all,

We have the StratusHealth two-day onsite (May 26–27) at the Palo Alto office. Headcount by day: Wed 220, Thu 185. Arrival window will be tight both mornings (8:30–9:30).

Ask: can you propose a short operational plan for ground transport that covers three items we need locked down by next Tuesday (5/18):
- Staggered arrival windows by cohort (VIPs, speakers, general attendees) with recommended pickup time windows for car services/vanpools.
- A vanpool/ridepool tiering and fallback plan if rideshare surge or traffic causes capacity gaps.
- Key-drop and badge pickup protocol for drivers delivering rental vehicles or courtesy cars (we need clear SLA for when keys are handed to on-site security).

Attached: site_parking_map.pdf with loading zones (ground level) and a proposed temporary valet stall near loading dock B.

Notes: StratusHealth is asking for an explicit ADA + infant seat plan and wants to avoid attendees waiting more than 10 minutes at curb. Pricing is secondary in this doc — operational behavior is first.

Thanks — please keep replies inline so I can forward the combined plan to Elena next week.

Marissa

Subject: Re: Arrival stagger, vanpool tiers, and key-drop protocol for StratusHealth workshop

Marissa —

Thanks for the context and the map. High-level proposal from GroundLink ops:

1) Stagger windows (recommended):
   - 08:00–08:20 VIPs + speakers (limit to single-occupancy car service + 2 courtesy SUVs)
   - 08:15–08:45 Vanpool lanes (12-passenger shuttles / 15 passenger vans) for group transfers from nearby hotels
   - 08:30–09:30 General rideshare + shared vans (dynamically scaled)

   We suggest an overlap with VIPs and vanpools (08:15–08:20) to give a buffer.

2) Tiering/fallback:
   - Primary: contracted car services (GroundLink, Pacific Chauffeurs) with dedicated pickup stalls
   - Secondary: scheduled hotel vanpools with manifests (we can stage two standby vans per hotel)
   - Tertiary: rideshare pooling (Uber/LYFT) with dispatch liaison on-site to reassign pooled vehicles to staging when surge occurs. We operate a priority queue for pickups when app surge > 2x normal; drivers go to staging gate.

3) Key-drop protocol suggestion:
   - Drivers deliver car to loading dock B, present company ID, and hand keys to on-site security desk (badge-verified). Security logs time, driver name, vehicle model, and intended return time. Keys stored in locked box; a single on-site key liaison (named person) will be listed on the key manifest.

We can provide vanpool_manifest.csv with preloaded attendee groups and phone numbers; this helps speed check-in. Also can supply two ADA-equipped vehicles per day as requested.

Pricing estimate included in separate attachment if you want (not included here).

— GroundLink Ops
GroundLink Operations Manager

Subject: Re: Arrival stagger, vanpool tiers, and key-drop protocol for StratusHealth workshop

Thanks — this looks good. A few operational items to lock down:

- Badge pickup: Security will open the badge table at 07:45. Drivers delivering multiple vehicles should drop keys at security no later than 08:15 to ensure cars are staged by 08:30. If drivers arrive earlier, they should wait in the vendor lane (per map).
- Key manifest: we need a CSV with the vehicle VIN/plate, driver phone, and exact ETA. GroundLink, can you confirm you can produce vanpool_manifest.csv by 5/18?
- Short-term parking: please reserve 6 transient stalls for overflow vendors (one of them ADA) — I added a note in the map margin.
- Ridepool wait max: set on-site liaison authority to redirect any pooled ride that has a wait >10 minutes to our standby shuttle; drivers will be paged.

Also: how will we handle after-event returns (late pickups)? We had an incident at a previous workshop where keys were misplaced during a late pickup window. Recommend a single key-handling liaison (on-shift contact + cell) and a logbook with timestamps. I drafted a one-page key_drop-protocol.docx and attached; please review and flag anything missing.

Lauren Bishop
Onsite Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

All — final consolidated plan below and action items. I’ve attached the vanpool_manifest.csv and updated key_drop-protocol.docx per Lauren’s notes. Also added a short badge map overlay in the Drive link.

Decisions (agreed):
- Stagger windows: VIP 08:00–08:20; Vanpool 08:15–08:45; General 08:30–09:30. Buffer overlap retained.
- Tiering: GroundLink (primary), hotel vanpools (secondary), rideshare fallback with on-site liaison (tertiary).
- ADA + infant seats: GroundLink will guarantee 2 ADA-equipped vehicles per day and accept infant-seat requests via manifest.
- Key-drop: Single on-site liaison (Lauren Bishop) will hold keys in locked box; GroundLink/Pacific Chauffeurs drivers and Stratus volunteers will sign ID and be logged. Late pickups (after 19:00) will require security escort and a second sign-off.

Action items and owners:
